sn35.163:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.163:1.2: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā …pe… vihareyyanti.
sn35.163:1.3: yaṃ kho koṭṭhita dukkhaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.163:1.5: cakkhuṃ kho koṭṭhita dukkhaṃ. tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.163:1.6: rūpā dukkhā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.163:1.7: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.163:1.8: cakkhusamphasso dukkho, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.163:1.9: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo; sotaṃ dukkhaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ dukkhaṃ …pe…
sn35.163:1.11: mano dukkho, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.163:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.163:1.16: yaṃ kho koṭṭhita dukkhaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabboti.
